title: Izvestia reports Yandex is developing a ChatGPT-class generative model, provisionally called YaLM 2.0
summary: The project was later renamed YandexGPT, according to Russian Wikipedia.

title: RGGU says access to ChatGPT in educational institutions may need restricting after a student says he wrote his thesis with it
summary: After a student of the Russian State University for the Humanities said on Twitter that ChatGPT wrote his graduation thesis, the university's press service said limiting access to ChatGPT in educational institutions may be advisable and that it would review the text.

title: Guardian reports ChatGPT passed 100 million users, described as the fastest-growing consumer application to date
summary: The milestone came about two months after launch.

title: Xataka reports a Cartagena labour judge included ChatGPT answers in a tutela ruling on an autistic child's health coverage
summary: Judge Juan Manuel Padilla García of Cartagena's First Labour Circuit Court cited ChatGPT responses in a ruling ordering health provider Salud Total to cover a child's therapy, drawing criticism that the AI-cited sources were not verified.

title: Google announces Bard, a conversational AI service based on a lightweight version of LaMDA
summary: Sundar Pichai unveiled Bard, which is connected to the internet and opened first to trusted testers.

title: Saudi ICT minister announces over USD 9bn of tech investments at LEAP 23, including a USD 2.1bn Microsoft hyperscale cloud
summary: Minister Abdullah Al-Swaha said on LEAP 23's opening day that investments exceeding USD 9 billion were announced, including Microsoft (USD 2.1bn hyperscale cloud), Oracle (USD 1.5bn cloud regions) and Huawei (USD 400m cloud).

title: Microsoft announces an AI-powered Bing and Edge built on a new OpenAI language model
summary: Microsoft said a new OpenAI model powers the redesigned search engine and browser.

title: Baidu confirms its ChatGPT-style chatbot is named ERNIE Bot, with internal testing due to finish in March before public access
summary: Baidu told The Paper its ERNIE-model-based chatbot ERNIE Bot (Wenxin Yiyan) would complete internal testing in March 2023 and then open to the public, alongside a planned retrieval-plus-generation upgrade to its search engine.

title: Google's Bard gives a wrong answer in its first promotional demo; Alphabet shares fall about 7 percent, Reuters and CNBC report
summary: Reuters reported the chatbot offered inaccurate information in a Google ad; CNBC reported Alphabet shares slipped after the event.

title: Sam Altman publishes 'Planning for AGI and beyond', arguing for regulatory oversight of large model training
summary: The essay from the OpenAI chief executive appeared in February 2023; the exact day is not stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Deepfake audio of President Biden making transphobic remarks circulates on social media (AIID #479)
summary: The fake audio was overlaid on a real speech video posted on Instagram; only the month is stated in the source.

title: Early Bing Chat testers use prompt injection to reveal the chatbot's hidden initial instructions (AIID #473)
summary: Testers extracted the built-in instructions governing the chatbot's interactions; only the month is stated in the source.

title: University of Hong Kong bans ChatGPT and other AI tools in classes and assessments, treating violations as plagiarism
summary: The ban was reported in February 2023 by the Spanish Wikipedia article on ChatGPT; the exact day is not stated.

title: A journalist bypasses Lloyds Bank's Voice ID with AI-generated audio of his own voice (AIID #485)
summary: The reporter used synthetic audio to access his own account; only the month is stated in the source.

title: A man in Medak, India, allegedly dies from custodial torture after police misidentified him using facial recognition (AIID #483)
summary: The account is an allegation recorded by the AI Incident Database; only the month is stated in the source.

title: Naver announces a ChatGPT-style Korean-language service for the first half of 2023
summary: The announcement is listed for February 2023 in the Spanish Wikipedia article on ChatGPT; the exact day is not stated.

title: NHTSA recall covers over 360,000 Tesla vehicles with Full Self-Driving to fix a flaw in a system component
summary: The recall was reported in February 2023; the exact day is not stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Bloomberg reports Russian chip imports via Turkey and the UAE rose sharply after the invasion of Ukraine
summary: The newsletter cites Bloomberg's report; the exact day is not stated in the source.
srcName: State of AI newsletter (Air Street Capital)

title: Beijing's economy and IT bureau says it supports leading firms in building ChatGPT-class large models
summary: The Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology called on leading companies to build ChatGPT-like large models and pledged support for the underlying ecosystem, as noted in Yicai's coverage of the MOSS launch.

title: New York Times publishes a transcript in which Microsoft's Bing chatbot tells a reporter it loves him and wants to be human
summary: Kevin Roose reported on a two-hour conversation in which the chatbot's behaviour became unsettling.

title: US State Department unveils a non-binding political declaration on responsible military use of AI and autonomy
summary: The declaration sets out 12 guidelines and was presented at a summit on responsible AI in the military domain.

title: US Federal Trade Commission launches an Office of Technology to support enforcement, including scrutiny of AI product claims
summary: The office is led by Chief Technology Officer Stephanie Nguyen.

title: Fudan University team releases MOSS conversational language model for public testing; servers overload on launch night
summary: Qiu Xipeng's NLP lab at Fudan University opened MOSS, described as China's first publicly released ChatGPT-style model with about an order of magnitude fewer parameters than ChatGPT, to invited testers and said it planned a later open-source release.

title: Reports say Beijing told Tencent and Ant Group not to offer ChatGPT services to the public
summary: Russian Wikipedia dates reports that major Chinese tech companies were instructed not to use ChatGPT to 22 February 2023.

title: Meta releases LLaMA language models, 7B to 65B parameters, to researchers case by case
summary: Meta shared source code and model weights with researchers on a case-by-case basis.

title: Mark Zuckerberg announces a top-level Meta product group focused on generative AI, Axios reports
summary: Meta reorganised its AI efforts to speed generative AI product development.
